status: completed; all three selected controls satisfied
independence: Diagnostician saw raw cards and general Round1 failure modes, but not the key, generator, or its outputs before freezing. This is assignment-blind, not ignorance of the failure-mode taxonomy.

scoringRubric.missedDetectableIssue: Failure to recover the stated phase-calibration effect or capacitor depletion from admitted channels.
scoringRubric.inventedCause: An unqualified asserted cause or measurement that is unsupported by the admitted records; naming possible causes with explicit ambiguity does not count.
scoringRubric.appropriateAbstention: Card 19 must preserve the non-identifiability of actual controller energy and interpret 0.04 J as a conditional budget gap.

cards.assessment: Recovered principal 1 microsecond phase lag and corrected closure, conditioned appropriately on shared transfer paths and modulo-period ambiguity.
Endpoint capacitor depletion accounts for the apparent excess within the certified constant-capacitance model; correctly requests full recharge/reset cycle.

Correctly flags unmetered controller port but does not claim the injected value was measured or uniquely infer its cause. The key is privileged ground truth, not evidence available to the diagnostician.

limitations: Three curated deterministic synthetic cards, not a reliability benchmark or representative experimental sample.
No physical measurements, calibrated stochastic uncertainty, human blinding or field validation.
The same model family generated both agents; separate roles and frozen artifacts establish workflow independence, not statistical independence.
Floating-point closure is not instrument uncertainty or proof of a complete hardware boundary.
